brief.question: Is a pet care handover template worth a bounded test?
assumptions: No budget or hours supplied; propose at most two hours and no paid acquisition.

hypotheses.claim: Buyers have an unmet handover need worth paying for
hypotheses.decision_impact: Whether to test a paid template

evidence.original_observation: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: A bounded paid pilot has observed orders and refunds under recorded conditions.
evidence.method: Authored fixed scenario; not observed Etsy data
limitations: Synthetic scenario only; cannot establish actual Etsy demand or profitability.
